### Travelers Schedules Conference Call to Review Third Quarter 2026 Results


September 14, 2026


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:[TRV](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2F&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=TRV&index=1&md5=0ddccd041678252fcc02bef8ca513e4a) ) will review its third quarter 2026 results at 9 a.m. ET on Friday, Oct. 16, following the release of results earlier that morning.


Investors can access the call via webcast at[investor.travelers.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.travelers.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.travelers.com&index=2&md5=98e09022abfddec874c1e261728b003b) and by dialing 833-461-5787 within the United States or 585-542-9983 outside the United States. A slide presentation, statistical supplement and live audio broadcast will be available on the same website.


Following the event, replays will be available via webcast for one year at[investor.travelers.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.travelers.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.travelers.com&index=3&md5=a6a10515c8ea7dba32b130e0844a2725) and by telephone for seven days by dialing 833-309-1852 within the United States or 929-828-5978 outside the United States. All callers should use conference ID 686305383.


**About Travelers** The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:[TRV](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2F&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=TRV&index=4&md5=53f19c8ed4970e8ed68d39db5de238d1) ) is a leading provider of property casualty insurance for[auto](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2Fcar-insurance&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=auto&index=5&md5=985e6f40dcd32ca6c18225781549bc5a) ,[home](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2Fhome-insurance&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=home&index=6&md5=514385d763b051b64ef88235e9d94fa8) and[business](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2Fbusiness-insurance&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=business&index=7&md5=f9f4d953ae4ab3f9992fea6c7e92fe89) . A component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Travelers has more than 30,000 employees and generated revenues of nearly $49 billion in 2025. For more information, visit[Travelers.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2F&esheet=54603438&newsitemid=20260914874248&lan=en-US&anchor=Travelers.com&index=8&md5=eeb63fd66492ca4665d00f3b0d56efa8) .
